html:
G'oya

Har bir signal uchun shu muzlatkichning oldingi signali kerak, uni LAG beradi. Oraliq 15 daqiqadan ko'p bo'lsa, bu uzilish. Keyin rejali uzilishlarni olib tashlaymiz: NOT EXISTS bilan "bu uzilishni to'liq o'z ichiga olgan ta'mir bormi" deb so'raymiz.

Yechim

Faqat PostgreSQLWITH s AS (
  SELECT fridge_id, sent_at,
         LAG(sent_at) OVER (PARTITION BY fridge_id ORDER BY sent_at) AS prev_at
  FROM readings
)
SELECT fridge_id, prev_at AS gap_start, sent_at AS gap_end,
       CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM sent_at - prev_at) / 60 AS INTEGER) AS gap_min
FROM s
WHERE sent_at > prev_at + INTERVAL '15 minutes'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM maintenance m
    WHERE m.fridge_id = s.fridge_id
      AND s.prev_at >= m.starts_at
      AND s.sent_at <= m.ends_at
  )

Muzlatkichning birinchi signalida prev_at NULL, shart NULL beradi va qator o'tmaydi. Namunada 2-muzlatkichning 08:07 dan 09:30 gacha uzilishi ta'mir ichida, 09:35 dan 10:00 gachasi esa ta'mir tugagandan keyin tugaydi va hisobga olinadi.

Tuzoqlar

Uzilish "to'liq ichida" bo'lishi kerak: oldingi signal ta'mir boshlangandan keyin, keyingisi ta'mir tugashidan oldin. Oraliqlar shunchaki kesishsa, bu yetmaydi. Kesishish sharti bilan 09:35 dan 10:00 gacha uzilish ham yo'qolardi.

Ta'mirni muzlatkich bo'yicha bog'lashni unutmang, aks holda bitta muzlatkichning ta'miri boshqasining uzilishini ham oqlaydi.

Daqiqalarni EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM ...) bilan olmang: 65 daqiqalik oraliqda u 5 qaytaradi. PostgreSQL'da sent_at - prev_at son emas, interval, uni 15 bilan solishtirib bo'lmaydi.

Noto'g'riWITH s AS (
  SELECT fridge_id, sent_at,
         LAG(sent_at) OVER (PARTITION BY fridge_id ORDER BY sent_at) AS prev_at
  FROM readings
)
SELECT fridge_id, prev_at, sent_at,
       CAST(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM sent_at - prev_at) AS INTEGER) AS gap_min
FROM s
WHERE EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM sent_at - prev_at) > 15

Dialektlar farqi

SQLite'da vaqtga daqiqa qo'shishni datetime qiladi, farqni soniyalarda strftime('%s', ...) beradi:

Faqat SQLiteWITH s AS (
  SELECT fridge_id, sent_at,
         LAG(sent_at) OVER (PARTITION BY fridge_id ORDER BY sent_at) AS prev_at
  FROM readings
)
SELECT fridge_id, prev_at AS gap_start, sent_at AS gap_end,
       (CAST(strftime('%s', sent_at) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%s', prev_at) AS INTEGER)) / 60 AS gap_min
FROM s
WHERE sent_at > datetime(prev_at, '+15 minutes')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM maintenance m
    WHERE m.fridge_id = s.fridge_id
      AND s.prev_at >= m.starts_at
      AND s.sent_at <= m.ends_at
  )

julianday farqini 1440 ga ko'paytirish ham daqiqa beradi, lekin kasr son: ROUND siz 30 daqiqa 29.9999 bo'lib chiqishi mumkin.
